ROLES.TITLE: Discord Roles
ROLES.SELECT_ROLE_DESC: Click on a role in the list to view details and permissions.
ROLES.NO_MANAGE_ROLES_PERM: The bot does not have the ManageRoles permission. Roles can only be viewed, not edited.
ROLES.REASON_MANAGED: This role is managed by Discord (Bot/Boost) and cannot be edited.
ROLES.REASON_HIGHER: This role is higher than the bot's role and cannot be edited.
ROLES.NAME: Role Name
ROLES.HOIST_HELP: Members with this role will be displayed separately in the member list.
ROLES.MENTIONABLE_HELP: Anyone can mention this role with @rolename.
ROLES.PERM_HINT: Discord permissions for this role. Changes apply immediately on the server.
ROLES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete this role? This action cannot be undone!

CHANNELS.TITLE: Discord Channels
CHANNELS.READ_ONLY_HINT: This page lists the server's channels. Nothing can be changed here — creating and editing channels has not been built yet.
CHANNELS.NO_MANAGE_CHANNELS_PERM: The bot does not have the ManageChannels permission.
CHANNELS.SELECT_CHANNEL_DESC: Click on a channel in the list to see its details.

ROLEMENUS.TITLE: Role menus
ROLEMENUS.SUBTITLE: Members assign roles to themselves — via reactions, buttons or a dropdown
ROLEMENUS.SENT: The menu is now in the channel.
ROLEMENUS.UPDATED: The message in the channel has been updated.
ROLEMENUS.EMPTY_HINT: Create one so members can assign their own roles — for games, colours or notifications, for example.
ROLEMENUS.NO_CHANNEL: No channel selected for this menu yet — it cannot be sent.
ROLEMENUS.NO_ENTRIES: This menu has no entries yet — it cannot be sent.
ROLEMENUS.DELETE_HINT: A message that has already been sent stays in the channel but stops working. Delete it yourself in Discord if you want it gone.
ROLEMENUS.FIELD_TITLE_PH: e.g. Which games do you play?
ROLEMENUS.FIELD_STYLE_HINT: Buttons and dropdowns can tell the member why something did not work. Reactions cannot.
ROLEMENUS.MODE_NORMAL_DESC: On and off: using it grants the role, using it again gives the role back.
ROLEMENUS.MODE_ONCE_DESC: The role is granted and stays. Good for rule agreements or a starter role nobody should lose by accident.
ROLEMENUS.MODE_UNIQUE_DESC: Only one role from this menu. Picking a second one removes the first — for colours, factions or time zones.
ROLEMENUS.MODE_REVERSE_DESC: The other way round: using it removes the role instead of granting it. For opt-outs such as "no more announcements".
ROLEMENUS.HELP_HIERARCHY_TEXT: The bot can only grant roles that sit below its own. If someone moves the bot role down, a menu stops working without warning. With buttons and dropdowns the member at least gets an explanation.
ROLEMENUS.FIELD_ENTRY_DESC_PH: Second line in the dropdown — only visible there
ROLEMENUS.FIELD_ENABLED_HINT: When switched off the message stays in the channel but stops working.
ROLEMENUS.CHANNEL_CHANGE_HINT: A different channel creates a new message the next time you send. The old one stays and stops working.
ROLEMENUS.EXISTING_DESC: Instead of its own message, the menu can attach to one already in the channel — your rules post, for example.
ROLEMENUS.EXISTING_HINT: In Discord: right-click the message → "Copy Message Link". With the link it is found reliably.
ROLEMENUS.EXISTING_REQUIRED: Please enter a message link or ID.
ROLEMENUS.EXISTING_FOREIGN_HINT: This message is not from the bot. Its text and embed stay untouched — only reactions are possible, no buttons.
ROLEMENUS.SWITCHED_TO_REACTION: The presentation was switched to reactions: buttons are not possible on someone else's message.
ROLEMENUS.UNLINK_HINT: The message stays in the channel along with its reactions. It simply stops working.
ROLEMENUS.UNLINK_CONFIRM: Really unlink? The message stays in the channel but stops working.

PERMS.VIEW_DESC: Allows opening the Discord area in the dashboard
PERMS.ROLES_VIEW_DESC: Allows seeing the server's roles and their permissions
PERMS.ROLES_EDIT_DESC: Allows creating and changing roles — takes effect immediately on the Discord server
PERMS.ROLES_DELETE_DESC: Allows deleting roles for good — cannot be undone
PERMS.CHANNELS_VIEW_DESC: Allows viewing the server's channels and categories
PERMS.ROLEMENUS_VIEW_DESC: Allows viewing the server's role menus
PERMS.ROLEMENUS_MANAGE_DESC: Allows creating, changing and sending role menus to a channel. Whoever may do this indirectly decides which roles members can give themselves
